tests.name: serializer_inline_macro_defined
tests.intent: Verify that JSON_INTERNAL_SERIALIZER_INLINE macro is defined after including json.hpp and properly undefined by macro_unscope.hpp.

tests.name: deep_nesting_dump_basic
tests.intent: Exercise dump() on a deeply nested json array to trigger the serializer container recursion and helper inlining paths.

tests.name: deep_nesting_pretty_dump
tests.intent: Exercise pretty-printing dump(2) on a deeply nested object to invoke put_indent and literal helpers inside the serializer.

tests.name: serializer_string_buffer_reserve
tests.intent: Dump strings with various unicode code points to trigger reserve_string_buffer and emit_pending serializer helpers.

tests.name: recursion_depth_limit_custom
tests.intent: Test serialization behavior when configuring a custom small recursion depth limit via json_pointer or deep structures.

tests.name: serializer_escaped_characters
tests.intent: Serialize objects containing various keys and string values needing heavy escaping to exercise dump_element.

tests.name: ordered_json_deep_serialization
tests.intent: Ensure ordered_json works correctly with the modified serializer helpers during deep nesting dumps.

tests.name: serializer_empty_containers
tests.intent: Dump empty arrays and objects at various depths to test boundary condition handling in serializer helpers.

tests.name: serializer_floats_and_numbers
tests.intent: Serialize extreme numerical values (inf, nan, large ints, small floats) using the serializer.

tests.name: serializer_binary_values
tests.intent: Serialize binary subtype values to check interaction with serializer helpers.

tests.name: serializer_binary_with_subtype
tests.intent: Serialize binary values with explicit user subtype using the standard serializer.

tests.name: serializer_wide_array
tests.intent: Serialize a wide array with many elements to test buffer management and loop efficiency in the serializer.

tests.name: serializer_wide_object
tests.intent: Serialize a wide object with many keys to verify key sorting and formatting helpers.

tests.name: serializer_mixed_nesting
tests.intent: Serialize complex alternating arrays and objects to test deep recursive frame unwinding.

tests.name: serializer_custom_indent_char
tests.intent: Test pretty-printing with different indentation character counts and check serializer helper behavior.

tests.name: serializer_indent_char_tabs
tests.intent: Test serialization using tab indentation characters instead of spaces.

tests.name: serializer_error_handler
tests.intent: Test serialization with a custom error handler function for unrepresentable characters.

tests.name: serializer_dump_to_output_adapter
tests.intent: Test dumping JSON directly to a standard output stream via serializer output adapters.

tests.name: macro_scope_header_sanity
tests.intent: Check that including macro_scope.hpp and macro_unscope.hpp directly works without issues.

tests.name: serializer_heavy_stress_dump
tests.intent: Perform repeated serialization of moderately deep structures to ensure stability and correctness of serializer helpers.

tests.name: deep_nesting_dump_basic_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise dump() on a deeply nested json array to trigger the serializer container recursion and helper inlining paths.
